Penglai channel-weixin reimplements a minimal subset of the publicly documented
Weixin iLink HTTP/JSON protocol. Protocol field names and login endpoint
behavior were understood by reading the MIT-licensed official repository:

  https://github.com/Tencent/openclaw-weixin
  commit cef0bfc390393f716903e16d50408118047f87e0
  package @tencent-weixin/openclaw-weixin@2.4.6

Tencent is pleased to support the open source community by making
openclaw-weixin available.

Copyright (C) 2026 Tencent. All rights reserved.

openclaw-weixin is licensed under the MIT License. See the official
repository LICENSE file. Penglai does not vendor the OpenClaw plugin
glue and does not depend on the OpenClaw runtime.
